integrity.reproducibility: Standalone exhaustive checker and a length-independent combinatorial proof are embedded.
scientific_limitations: Only up to two adjacent swaps; no code-size optimum proved.
Prior-publication equivalence under unsearched terminology remains possible.
The all-distinct specialization is known, not claimed new.
integrity.scientific_scope: Any finite alphabet and word length at least two; sharp maximum for alphabet size at least three and uniform mean for size at least two.

title: Exact radius-two Kendall swap balls for words with repeated symbols
